description: This file defines a service function 'getUserProjectsFromSessions' that retrieves and aggregates user project data from session tracking and project models in a MongoDB database. It includes logic for filtering by tenant, user, and optional time ranges, and enriches project data with project names when available.

methods.name: getUserProjectsFromSessions
methods.description: Aggregates distinct projects for a user within a tenant, optionally filtered by time range, and enriches with project names if available.
